Priya Patel: I'm in. Can we reserve a couple extra bats?
Samir Rao: Count me in too. Got a friend who can ump if needed.
Megan Liu: Might be late (flight). Put me down as maybe.
Alex Kim: Cool — @Megan Liu noted. @Priya Patel can you bring first-aid kit?
Priya Patel: Yep, I can. Also can someone bring sunscreen?
Samir Rao: I’ll bring some sunscreen and a spare glove.
Megan Liu: If worst comes to worst, I can join remotely to cheer lol :cheer:
Alex Kim: Ha! We'll reserve field at Riverside Park — gives easy transit. 10am-1pm tentatively.
Priya Patel: RSVP list: Alex, Priya, Samir, Megan(maybe). Anyone else?
Samir Rao: @Jordan Lee should join (he’s competitive).
Jordan Lee: I can make it, bringing my A-game :muscle:
